id.description: The order's identity — this bounded context's contribution to the platform.

status.description: The order-level status, ALWAYS derived from the line statuses and never stored, so it cannot drift out of sync with the lines it summarises. `Received` -> `Allocated` | `PartiallyAllocated` | `Backordered` -> `Released` | `PartiallyReleased`, with `Cancelled` reachable only from a pre-release state (BR6).
status.title: OrderStatus

requiredShipBy.description: The externally-dictated deadline this order was received with, or absent when it has none (the overwhelming majority). See the same field on ReceiveOrderRequest.

releaseOnAllocation.description: False means the order was HELD at intake (ADR 0020): allocated but deliberately not released, awaiting `POST /orders/{id}/release`. True for every order received without the flag, including every order predating ADR 0020.

promiseDate.description: The date this order is promised for, RFC 3339. Computed at allocation time by the domain lead-time policy as "now plus the slowest lead time among the allocated lines' process paths". Absent until at least one line is allocated. v1 uses a configurable static lead time, not a live carrier rate — see the README's "Deferred (v1)" section.

lineNo.description: The line's 1-based position within its order.

quantity.description: Quantity ordered, as received (and validated) at intake — see the matching int64 note on ReceiveOrderLineRequest.quantity.

pathId.description: The process path assigned to this line, ALWAYS the internal default (`pick`) — a caller placing an order has no business supplying wes-work-planning's process-path vocabulary at intake, so this is read-only: visible in every response, never settable on the request.

status.description: The per-line status. `Pending` -> `Allocated` (inventory-storage reserved) or `Backordered` (inventory-storage answered 409); `Backordered` -> `Allocated` ONLY via retry-allocation; `Allocated` -> `Released` (wes-work-planning accepted the work); any pre-release state -> `Cancelled`.
status.title: OrderLineStatus

reservationId.description: inventory-storage's reservation id, present only once the line is allocated. A reference only — this context models no local Reservation aggregate, because inventory-storage remains the sole owner of reservation state. Omitted (rather than empty) when the line is not allocated.

400.description: The request body or path parameter is malformed or invalid — including a body whose JSON is syntactically valid but shape-invalid: an explicitly null value on a non-nullable field (e.g. `"giftWrap": null`) is rejected here rather than silently coerced to that field's zero value.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error shape, used for every non-2xx response across this service — the same shape the other five services in this platform emit.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve). Unique per distinct error category in this service.

title.description: Fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code as an integer (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.
